items.title: Capcom is preparing for a ‘future where we create games together with AI’
items.excerpt: During a presentation on the future of RE Engine, Capcom laid out its plans to embrace AI in ‘development workflows.’
items.rationale: A major publisher formally puts AI into its RE Engine development roadmap, which is a concrete studio-level workflow decision. Not previously covered.

items.title: Stardock unveils Clairvoyance AI productivity tools for game devs and more | exclusive
items.excerpt: Brad Wardell's Stardock unveiled Clairvoyance, a set AI tools that is making game developers and other more productive.
items.rationale: A new AI tool suite for game developers. This is the pool's strongest actionable release.

items.title: Vibe-coded mashup mods are flooding X/Twitter, and modders hate it
items.excerpt: A wave of AI-decompiled mashup mods has taken over X/Twitter this week.
items.rationale: This week's new wave of AI-decompiled mashup mods and the backlash from modders. It is a distinct event from the earlier Banjo-Tooie and Ocarina port stories.

items.title: "Support modders, not AI": Total War: Warhammer 3 mod "deliberately corrupted" by its own creator in protest of AI-infused unauthorised reuploads
items.excerpt: Total War: Warhammer 3 mod SFO: Grimhammer 3 has been "deliberately corrupted" by its own creator in protest of AI-infused unauthorised reuploads.
items.rationale: A concrete creator action: the SFO: Grimhammer 3 author sabotaged his own mod to counter AI-altered reuploads. It is a new incident.

items.title: Activision And Bethesda Crackdown On GenAI MW2 And Fallout Projects
items.excerpt: Vibe coders are getting legal notices
items.rationale: Follow-up. The new action is Activision's legal notice against a genAI MW2 project. The Bethesda Fallout C&D was already published on 10-03, so the copy must lead with Activision. Note: og_image is a 2020 Kotaku stock image.

https://kotaku.com/activision-and-bethes.new_action: Activision issued legal notices against a genAI Modern Warfare 2 fan project. The Bethesda Fallout C&D was already published on 2026-10-03.
